newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs slow as traders wait for industry data.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs slow as traders wait for industry data.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to slightly higher on Friday as traders waited for API data due out on Tuesday.
Propane deals in the Mont Belevieu, Texas, market were done at 34.75 and 35.00 cents a gallon. Values were unchanged from Thurday's mark of 35.00/35.25.
Material in the Conway, Kansas market was traded at 34.38 cents a gallon, and values held steady at 34.00/34.25.
Natural gasoline prices increased a quarter cent in Belvieu to 43.25/43.75 amid higher NYMEX prices for crude oil, one trader said.
In Conway, natural gasoline values merged closer as the buying price moved up a quarter cent to 43.25 and the selling price remained steady at 43.50 cents a gallon.
Dealers were "content to hold their numbers and content to play wait and see," said one trader.

That sentiment was reflected in the ethane purity market in both Belvieu and Conway as players reported steady values and little trading. Ethane mix also held steady at 18.75/19.00 cents a gollon in Belvieu.
